interpretation: K_H_scaling = K_H(Eq. 6)/p. K_H_homogeneous = K_H(Eq. 6)*N/E_q[k] uses the mean neighbor degree and no degree spread. (K_H_homogeneous-K_H_scaling)/K_H_scaling = (2p-1)/(1+(N-2)p), which equals 1/(N-1) only at p=1. heterogeneity_deviation = (K_H_degree-K_H_homogeneous)/K_H_homogeneous is the correction from the spread of q(k).
